purpose: Pre-register synthetic experiments capable of discriminating minimal rival mechanisms for the two identified construct gaps before any candidate is implemented in the Pineland core.

G0_instant_presence.description: Insurgent governance is an instantaneous function of current local organizational presence/capacity; no persistent governance stock.

G1_capacity_stock.description: Local governance capacity is a persistent stock built by deliberate governance investment scaled by local organizational capacity/embeddedness and decaying when unsupported.
signature: growth possible without coercive events when governance investment is positive

G2_event_reinforcement.description: Governance capacity is reinforced primarily by successful taxation/regulation/coercion events and otherwise decays.
signature: no accumulation during silent investment without qualifying events

A0_instant_presence.description: Civilian access restriction is an instantaneous consequence of current actor physical presence/capability, with no separate access state.
signature: weak route specificity absent spatial presence differences

A1_edge_restriction_stock.description: Actor-route access restriction is an explicit edge/corridor stock built by blockade/interdiction effort and decaying when unsupported.

A2_discrete_blockade_event.description: Access restriction consists of explicit temporary blockade events with finite duration but no persistent stock beyond the event window.

identification_gate: Each rival pair must differ on at least two predeclared protocol-level signatures.
At least one discrimination must rely on persistence/decay rather than only level differences.
At least one governance discrimination must separate deliberate investment from successful coercion/event counts.
At least one access discrimination must include an adjacent-edge topology placebo.
No historical case value, residual, event rate, or control score may enter the candidate equations or discrimination thresholds.
post_historical_gate_sequence: Implement candidates only in an isolated experimental branch/worktree after the frozen historical confrontation is finalized.
Run the synthetic discrimination protocols before any historical rerun.
Reject candidates that fail their own synthetic signatures or cannot be separated from simpler rivals.
Only mechanisms surviving synthetic identification may become candidates for a new certified core; historical cases remain out-of-sample tests rather than tuning targets.
interpretation: Passing this contract validates the experimental design's ability to discriminate rival mechanisms; it does not select or validate any candidate mechanism.
